plan.describe:
Plan revision 0, tier graph: minimal plan (phase 1b)
  mode = graph  (molecular dynamics on the graph tier (SPEC §8.1))
  allow_reference = off  (not requested)
  superset = Na Cl  (declared (species=), equal to the structure's)
  force_precision = float64  (the ForceField's precision (SPEC §7.1, §9.2))
  software.oeq = off  (openequivariance is not installed)
  software.triton = on  (triton 3.8.0 is importable)
  software.nvrtc = on  (NVRTC 13.0 loads through cuda.bindings)
  software.fused_cueq = on  (cuequivariance_ops_torch imports)
  software.mace_imported_first = mace  (modules imported before FastMACE could prepare the OEq runtime)
  allow_naive_cueq = off  (not needed: no naive cuEq kernel)
  workload.max_temperature_K = 600 K  (MD only: phase 1a's skin and headroom; rule 11 would give skin 0.3 A, headroom 1.15 (fastest of 216 atoms at 600 K, lightest mass 22.9898 u, 0.5 fs: 0.0084 A per step, 16 steps per rebuild) (it applies to MC and species-change workloads))
  workload.host_callbacks_every = none  (no host callbacks)
  workload.mc_moves = none  (no MC)
  workload.species_changes = off  (rule 8 is not in 1b: species-dependent rewrites are built for the structure's species)
  workload.needs_per_atom = none  (recorded)
  tier = graph  (the research engine's --engine gpu: CUDA graphs, edge buckets (SPEC §8.1))
  workload = ok  (216 atoms, 3D PBC, no constraints)
  hardware = NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti  (compute capability 12.0, 15.9 GiB (recorded only))
  EngineConfig.backend = cueq  (reproducible=True: plain cuEq, the only qualified backend (SPEC §9.3 rule 5))
  PrecisionConfig.dtype = float64  (requested 'float64': cueq backend)
  EngineConfig.cueq_conv_fusion = off  (auto (on_for_plain_cueq_unless_reproducible): reproducible=True: the unfused convolution, whose messages MACE's scatter_add_ sums under the deterministic flag (owner decision 13))
  RewriteConfig.factor_species = off  (auto (on_for_hybrid_graph_engine_if_model_supports): stage 1: plain cuEq backend)
  RewriteConfig.fold_cutoff = off  (auto (on_with_factor_species_if_model_supports): stage 1: off (without factor_species))
  RewriteConfig.density_first = off  (auto (on_with_fold_cutoff_if_model_supports): stage 1: off (without fold_cutoff))
  RewriteConfig.reassociate_first = off  (auto (on_with_stage1_fold_cutoff_if_model_supports): stage 1: off (without fold_cutoff))
  RewriteConfig.joint_radial_input = off  (auto (on_with_fold_cutoff_if_model_supports): stage 1: off (without fold_cutoff))
  RewriteConfig.fused_folded_backward = off  (auto (on_with_stage1_fold_cutoff_if_model_supports): stage 1: off (without fold_cutoff))
  RewriteConfig.folded_backward_tiles = off  (auto (on_with_fused_folded_backward): stage 1: off (without fused_folded_backward))
  RewriteConfig.segmented_first_sum = off  (auto (on_with_reassociate_first_and_sort_receivers): stage 1: off (without reassociate_first and sort_receivers))
  RewriteConfig.fused_radial_hidden = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (no measured gain))
  RewriteConfig.direct_node_feats = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (OPT3-T05, opt-in))
  RewriteConfig.folded_constants = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (OPT3-T05, opt-in))
  RewriteConfig.streaming_conv = off  (auto (on_for_hybrid_with_stage1_fold_cutoff_and_sort_receivers_if_model_supports): stage 1: off (without the hybrid backend, fold_cutoff (stage 1) and sort_receivers (a hard requirement: streaming kernels on unsorted edges give wrong results)))
  RewriteConfig.block_linear = off  (auto (on_for_hybrid_graph_engine): stage 1: plain cuEq backend)
  RewriteConfig.grouped_linear = off  (auto (on_with_block_linear): stage 1: off (without block_linear))
  RewriteConfig.merged_residual = off  (auto (on_with_block_linear): stage 1: off (without block_linear))
  RewriteConfig.gated_rows = off  (auto (on_with_merged_residual): stage 1: off (without merged_residual))
  RewriteConfig.segment_gemm = off  (auto (on_with_gated_rows_float32_unless_reproducible): stage 1: off (without gated_rows))
  RewriteConfig.grouped_launch = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (opt-in until its A/B on both GPUs))
  RewriteConfig.species_skip = off  (auto (on_with_graph_engine_if_model_supports): stage 1: graph engine, any backend; stage 2: off, not supported by the model (no MACE-MP-0 or density-family interaction))
  RewriteConfig.single_graph_strain = on  (auto (on): acts where stress is computed (NPT))
  RewriteConfig.species_tables = off  (auto (on_float32_unless_reproducible_if_model_supports): stage 1: graph engine, any backend; stage 2: supported (ok); off: reproducible=True keeps the stock products)
  RewriteConfig.fold_readout_tail = off  (auto (on_with_block_linear_float32_unless_reproducible_if_model_supports): stage 1: off (without block_linear))
  RewriteConfig.fold_product_linear = off  (auto (on_with_species_tables_and_block_linear_if_model_supports): stage 1: off (without block_linear and species_tables))
  RewriteConfig.combo_kernels = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (opt-in until its A/B on both GPUs))
  NeighbourConfig.sort_receivers = off  (auto (on_for_hybrid_graph_engine): plain cuEq backend)
  NeighbourConfig.gpu_neighbour_list = on  (auto (on_with_graph_engine): graph engine)
  RewriteConfig.inplace_block_linear = off  (not carried over in 1a (SPEC §6.2: opt-in, slower))
  RewriteConfig.polar_uvu = on  (no effect: not a PolarMACE model)
  PolarConfig.kspace_headroom = n/a  (auto (variable_cell_0_1_else_0): not a PolarMACE model, no long range)
  EngineConfig.expandable_segments = on  (auto (on_for_torch_2_14_unless_alloc_conf_set): PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True before the first CUDA allocation)
  EngineConfig.compile_mode = default  (main.py's --compile-mode)
  EngineConfig.speculative_graph = off  (off unless requested (main.py default))
  EngineConfig.pipelined = on  (auto (on_with_graph_engine_unless_speculative): graph engine)
  EngineConfig.async_output = on  (auto (on_with_graph_engine): graph engine; the run loop's choice)
  capture = on  (CUDA graphs)
  integrator = LangevinBAOAB  (NPT, hydrostatic cell, externalstress=-0 (-0 GPa), disable_cell_langevin=False (workflow.baoab_settings))
  compute_stress = on  (variable cell (NPT))
  IntegratorConfig.fixcm_projection = ase  (auto (mass_weighted_under_nvt_fixcm_else_ase): NPT (LangevinBAOAB has no fixcm): no projection to choose)
  IntegratorConfig.dof = fastmace  (auto (owner_decision_d2_default): FastMACE's count: 3N - 3 under fixcm, 3(N - n_fixed) with FixAtoms (owner decision D2))
  NeighbourConfig.skin = 0.3 A  (auto (rule_11_skin_from_workload): phase 1a's skin: rule 11 sizes only MC and species-change workloads; rule 11 would give 0.3 A)
  NeighbourConfig.headroom = fixed  (auto (rule_11_headroom_from_workload): capacity_headroom 1.15 and edge_bucket_fraction as given; rule 11 would give 1.15)
  NeighbourConfig.d3_skin = unused  (auto (rule_11_d3_skin_from_workload): no D3 list; 1 A, the floor)
  EngineConfig.recapture_budget = 64  (auto (recapture_budget_from_workload): the graph variant cap (64): past it the run warns, records and the report recommends the compiled tier (3-T04))
  PrecisionConfig.mc_energy = float64  (auto (force_precision_if_move_energy_gate_passes_else_float64): the force precision: no MC moves, no MC energies)
  reproducible = qualified (cueq, mh1)  (plain cuEq mh1, unfused convolution, deterministic flags; 12 components on the allow-list; relies on CUEQUIVARIANCE_OPS_U1D_ALGOS=1,1, an undocumented internal of cuequivariance_ops 0.12.0 (libcue_ops.so), pins cuEq's run-time uniform_1d kernel choice)
  reproducible.environment = CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 TORCHINDUCTOR_DETERMINISTIC=1 CUEQUIVARIANCE_OPS_U1D_ALGOS=1,1  (set together with torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True) before CUDA starts (SPEC §8.7, owner decision 14); passed to the subprocess runner's children)
  requested: EngineConfig.backend=cueq, PrecisionConfig.dtype=float64
